name: Can garage trim installation improve my home's energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can garage trim installation improve my home's energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, properly installed garage trim can contribute to improved energy efficiency. When trim is correctly sealed and gaps around the garage door frame are eliminated, it reduces air leakage into and out of the garage. This helps maintain a more stable temperature inside the garage, which can indirectly impact the temperature of adjacent living spaces, reducing the workload on your HVAC system and potentially lowering energy bills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Properly installed and sealed garage trim reduces air leakage, helping maintain stable garage temperatures and indirectly improving home energy efficiency.
